## Case studies

- [Adaptive Assignment Engine](/work/adaptive-assignment-engine): Edfora, Senior Product Manager. A fixed practice sequence was the wrong difficulty for many learners. The engine estimated each learner's ability and matched it against question difficulty, discrimination and guessing parameters, with an LLM API adjusting difficulty from performance history. Assignment completion improved by roughly 18–25%; practice drop-offs reduced.
- [Onboarding Funnel Redesign](/work/onboarding-funnel-redesign): Witzeal Technologies (real-money gaming), Product Manager. Most drop-off happened before a player's second session. Redesigning the first 60 seconds took Day-7 retention from 12% to 25%.
- [AI Learner Diagnostic](/work/ai-learner-diagnostic): Independent portfolio prototype, not shipped at any employer and with no real users or model results. Shows the rules vs. model split, failure modes and fallbacks, evaluation rubric, confidence UX and teacher override.

## Other documented outcomes

- Edfora: quiz and gamification layer, designed around teachers who found early prototypes "too game-y": DAU up ~12–15%, average session time up ~15%.
- Edfora: real-time engagement dashboards for faculty replaced a monthly spreadsheet pull: student retention up ~8–12%. Learning and engagement products reached 100K+ learners.
- Witzeal: experimentation roadmap across pricing and reward loops: GMV growth ~10% week over week. Bonus allocation by expected ROI per segment: bonus spend down ~20% with retention held. Segmented lifecycle messaging: long-term retention stabilized at 48%.
- Baazi Games (PokerBaazi, Lagai Khai, FanBlaze): 20+ A/B tests, core funnel conversion up ~15%; behavioral segmentation, session duration up ~35% and retention up ~25%; rules-based fraud detection, fraud losses down ~18%.
- PwC India, Program & Release Manager: release process for a web application deployed to 150+ Fortune companies.
- Direct Create, Android Developer (2014–2018): sole Android developer; proposed one app with role selection for makers, buyers and designers instead of three apps. The platform grew to 400+ maker shops and 100+ designers.
